questions.stem: During neonatal resuscitation, If the HR is less than 100/min or apnea or gasping is present what measures would you take?

options.label: A
options.text: Start PPV by self-inflating the Bag and Mask

options.label: C
options.text: Reassess after 30 seconds, if the HR is not less than 100/min then the baby gets post-resuscitation care
